To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the E Framework is a service oriented framework that allows the development of e learning applications that can be used by different types of users, and that it can be used to support the development of e Learning 2.0 applications.
we have developed a service oriented framework to support text file evaluation processes in e learning.

the text file evaluation service is a service type that supports the evaluation of learning objects and the service usage model for text file evaluation describes a business process that involves a set of services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an abstract service for text file evaluation.
modelling the business processes of text file evaluation services and the service types that support them.
the development of a model for the specification and implementation of text file evaluation services.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a text file evaluation is a process that involves a set of services and a text file.
the service usage model is a formalization of the business process of text file evaluation.
a text file evaluation can be seen as a business process that is composed of several services.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have formalized a service type and a business process for text file evaluation.
the proposed service type and usage model are a step forward in formalizing text file evaluation.
we have developed a formal model for a text file evaluation that is independent from the evaluation process and can be reused in different contexts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a text file evaluation is a complex service that can be used by several e learning applications and business processes.
text file evaluation can be formalized as a service oriented business process and can be supported by an open source service oriented framework for e learning.
a text file evaluation is not a standalone process but a component of a larger process involving other services.
